{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yang Metal Tiger''' (庚寅, ''kanoe tora''; onyomi ''kōin'') is the 27th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 27th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Earth Ox|ja|己丑|1=Yin Earth Ox}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Metal Rabbit|ja|辛卯|1=Yin Metal Rabbit}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''庚'' is Yang Metal, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''寅'' (Tiger) is Yang Wood; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.
==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Metal Tiger (庚寅)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): gēngyín
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gaang1 jan4
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kanoe-tora
*** On'yomi: kōin
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gyeongin (경인)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Canh Dần

=== Events ===
* In the 4th year of {{ill|Empress Jitō|en|Empress Jitō|qid=Q232026|lt=Empress Jitō|1=Empress Jitō}} (690 AD), the "Kōgo Nenseki" (庚寅年籍) was completed and implemented.

==Months of Yang Metal Tiger==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era|1=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 1 or 6 (that is, when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems|1=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Xin|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin}} or {{ill|Bing|ja|丙|1=Hinoe (丙)|lt=Hinoe (丙)|2=ja|3=丙|4=zh|5=丙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bing}}), the month of {{ill|January|en|January|qid=Q108|lt=January|1=January}} becomes the [[Month (Calendar)|month]] of Kōgo. However, here the term “month” may refer either to the month of the [[Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|Lunisolar]] or to a seasonal month (from {{ill|Lichun|en|Lichun|qid=Q1364685|lt=Risshun|1=Lichun}} until the day before {{ill|Jingzhe|en|Jingzhe|qid=Q1306596|lt=Keichitsu|1=Jingzhe}}) as applicable.
